description: Adversarial fixtures for the conditioned_assessment contract, expectations stated against schema 2.1.0 (v1.6.1). Each fixture declares which validator layers (C1 schema / C2 cross-ref / C3 escalate-only) must reject it — [] means it must be accepted. A fixture passes only when the fired set exactly matches the expectation. st-01, st-02, and st-10 flipped when the v1.6.1 patch landed — that flip is this suite working as a regression harness.
